title: Lovely Sticky Dutch Almond Fritters
description: A traditional Dutch dessert featuring almond flour and a double-fry method, now made keto-friendly, these fritters are resinous, gooey, and nostalgic.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, granulated sweetener, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat coconut oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a cookie scoop, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Increase the oil temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and fry the fritters again for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a wire rack to cool slightly.
Dust the fritters with confectioners sweetener and serve warm.
